comparator.sourceNotes: External facts rechecked 2026-10-08 against the adopted 2026–2027 programme-specific OER, Article 5 (pp.6–7), and general OER Article 10. Year one has 60 EC required courses; year two has 15 EC taught requirements, 15 EC required German-speaking-country study and 30 EC genuinely free bachelor-level broadening space. It is not restricted to two Humanities minors. Year three has 30 EC restricted Faculty of Arts minor space, a 5-EC expert course and 10-EC bachelor tutorial/thesis. The ordinary formal table also repeats LET-DTCB229, LET-DTCB225 and LET-DTCB235, already required in year two. Their additional 15 EC cannot be counted as distinct content without a valid repeat/replacement rule. The prospective 2029–2030 page names different third-year courses; it cannot resolve the current formal/cohort discrepancy. The retained 165 EC is an allocation omitting those repeated rows, not the degree size or a certified complete pathway. Article 6 gives a conditional alternative for students abroad or taking the educational minor in third-year semester one; no applicability or approval is assumed merely to fill the gap. Mentoring and RADAr are required noncredit formation. The previous UCR judgment is retained in the remediation history; UCR comparability is not reassessed here. Noncredit requirements are LET-DTCB001 Mentoraat DTC (including the Berlin visit), LET-RADAR-NL academic language skills, and LET-DTCB2000 Mentoraat en PPO DTC B2; their 0 EC is not added to credited components.

exception.reason: The current ordinary-route OER repeats the same three 5-EC course codes in years two and three, while the future third-year prospectus names different courses. No current single-cohort repeat or replacement rule establishing 15 additional distinct EC has been verified. The formal conditional third-year alternative cannot be assumed without its stated mobility/educational-minor condition. The 180-EC degree size is known, but a complete current ordinary-route curriculum cannot yet be certified.
exception.curriculumContext: The adopted 2026–2027 OER and general rules establish the supported 60 + 60 + 45 EC allocation after removing three duplicated rows from the nominal 180 table. This 165-EC diagnostic does not reduce the degree size. Future prospectus pages are labelled 2027–2028, 2028–2029 and 2029–2030. Required second-year mobility remains separate from 30 EC free broadening space; third-year Faculty of Arts minor space is restricted. No UCR feasibility conclusion is made by this correction.
